interface.description: Name of the TAP interface to create (e.g., 'fastd0').

mode.description: Operational mode: client (outgoing only), server (incoming only), or hybrid (both).

peers_dir.description: Directory containing peer public key files (required for 'manual' and 'password' methods).

pre_shared_key_file.description: Path to file with pre-shared keys (required for 'psk' method).

secrets_dir.description: Directory containing secret key files (required for 'handshake' method).

bind_address.description: Local IP address to bind the UDP socket (optional).

port.description: UDP port to listen on (default: 9696; only used in server/hybrid mode).

mtu.description: Maximum transmission unit for the VPN interface.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup.

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup.

dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to push to connecting peers (server/hybrid mode only).

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed IP subnets for peer traffic (server/hybrid mode only).

handshake_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting a handshake.

id.description: Peer identifier (typically short hex fingerprint or alias).

name.description: Human-readable name for the peer (for comments/logs only).

public_key.description: Base32-encoded public key of the peer.

ip.description: Static IPv4 address assigned to this peer (e.g., '10.255.0.5').

psk.description: Base32-encoded pre-shared key for this peer (only for 'psk' method).

peers.description: List of trusted peers with static configuration.
